record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale each real history item's existing input embedding by 1+0.05*log1p(c_i)/log1p(max_j c_j), using counts computed exclusively from supplied training interactions. Mildly amplifying frequent observed items may strengthen reliable recurrent context; the previous attenuation trial motivates testing the opposite direction. Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. Preserve learned embedding design, topology, readout, loss and optimizer; save counts with each category's model and reproduce scaling through the predictor writer.
